plugins.description: Brevity codes for coding agents: a compact, public, human-auditable format for messages between agent sessions, designed to keep every identifier and decision-relevant fact. The brevity skill encodes and decodes messages on request. In Claude Code, projects that opt in with a .brevity/ folder also get the spec and their dictionary loaded at session start.
